verdict.rationale: The GitHub README documents an `x-preset` header that applies pre-packaged option bundles, including a `research` preset described as "for AI research agents needing structured, citable output". Related structured-output options back this up: frontmatter Markdown, semantic chunking into JSON, and JSON-schema extraction. Missing for 10: documentation of what the research preset actually bundles, a concrete description of the citation or source-attribution format, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the preset works as described.
